title: Doctor checks a bound verification's intended criteria against the target's acceptance at its recorded work revision
outcome: Doctor checks a bound verification's intended criteria against the target's acceptance at its recorded work revision
acceptance: doctor reports a bound verification record whose bound_from.criteria names a position greater than the number of acceptance criteria the target item had at the record's binding work_revision
a test forges such a record on an otherwise valid store and doctor reports it, while every record a valid bind writes still verifies
